bio: On the ground floor of what has become one of the icons of Turin's urban landscape - the Intesa San Paolo skyscraper designed by Renzo Piano - you will find the dedicated entrance to the restaurant. Here you will be accompanied to the lift with which, at great speed, you will ascend to a height of 150 metres: before sitting down in the restaurant proper, do not miss a “diversion” to the panoramic terrace from which you will enjoy a splendid view of the city centre.
